text:
maria: Quick sync — thinking about a small DP pilot tweak: offer a $500 bounty per partner (up to 3 seats) for completing the full feedback run + introduce a simple 3-tier qualifier matrix. want thoughts and any obvious blockers.

sam: I like the bounty. clarifying q: $500 per org or per seat? also, what counts as 'completed'? :thinking_face: 

maria: per org (flat). completed = attended kickoff + submitted weekly feedback for 6 weeks (survey + 1 product session). intention is to improve commitment.

lina: draft qualifier matrix below — short and actionable so recruiting ops can score quickly:
```
product_fit: 0-5 (need/use-case alignment)
infra_readiness: 0-3 (VPC/dedicated? yes=3)
commitment: 0-2 (can do weekly sessions?)
pass_threshold: >=8/10
```
pass if >=8. keeps us focused on partners who can run real workloads.

ashley: ops note — bounty payment + international tax is nontrivial. need legal template and PO process. can we make payments via vendor credits instead to simplify? :money_with_wings: 

derek: from sales: prioritize orgs already on dedicated or private deployment — faster onboarding + more actionable perf feedback. also call out customers running >=10k tokens/day.

sam: launch criteria suggestion: 10 partners signed, >=80% weekly survey completion across cohort, onboarding time <2 weeks for 80% of partners, and no critical regressions in eval suite.

maria: add canary rollout gating for any infra changes + rollback plan. also tie bounty to completion checks so we don't pay for partials.

lina: eval suite idea: baseline prompts set (10 prompts), measure median latency, cost/token, and semantic quality heuristics. flag >10% latency regression or >5% quality drop as regression.

ashley: action items from ops/legal side: I'll draft vendor contract template and a payments flow (credits vs wire). looping legal. need budget signoff.

maria: confirmed budget = $5k for first cohort (10 partners). I'll post recruitment brief and target list by EOD. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Please create #dp-recruiting channel and tag @legal for contract review.

maria: thanks — next check-in Friday 9am PT to review recruits and qualifier scores.

sam: I'll prototype the qualifier form in Typeform and share the link before Wednesday.

lina: I'll draft the eval prompt set and a small scoring rubric (automated + manual check).

ashley: noted — will track onboarding SLA and billing path.

derek: I'll surface 3 candidate customers from enterprise pipeline this afternoon.

maria: appreciate it all. goal: run first session in 3 weeks.

sam: :thumbsup:
